mods.name: Touch FX (Custom Core)
mods.author: mrdjjag
mods.summary: Panel only. Requires matching custom azmod.so and azstem.so; standard AZ-MODS is not supported.
mods.description: Custom-build beta for XDJ-AZ. Requires matching customised azmod.so and azstem.so; the .azmod alone is not a complete installation. STEMS Touch FX requires tracks separated using Kyle's AZ-MODS Mod Manager, with STEMS enabled on the selected deck. Sampler uses its own samples. See the source repository for firmware compatibility, build and developer-mode installation requirements.
